ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to ensure FCA Product Type field is populated before its being closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Complaints',
OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Upheld'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Not Upheld'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Redirected') ),
ISPICKVAL( FCA_Product_Type__c , "")
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: FCA Product Type cannot be blank
